item.title: Enable Project Gateway
item.description: This section describes how to enable a project gateway. Prerequisites The KubeSphere Gateway extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. You need to join a project and have the Project Gateway Management permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Project Gateway Management permissions and enter your workspace.

item.title: Disable Project Gateway
item.description: This section describes how to disable a project gateway. Warning After the gateway is disabled, clients will be unable to access services reverse-proxied by the gateway, which may interrupt related business operations. Please perform this operation with caution. Prerequisites The KubeSphere Gateway extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. You need to join a project and have the Project Gateway Management permission in the project.
